agenda: generalization claim hardening ahead of program review: is the incumbent's zero-shot skill direction-symmetric, and does the in-family gap replicate on a second training family?
question: Train on SHIFT-SUV estate (train split; test split stays sealed) and measure: in-family estate accuracy, zero-shot DrivAerML, zero-shot fastback -- for both the incumbent (GeoTransolver 9.5M) and the canonical MeshTransformer (homogeneous flagship 784k).
protocol: identical to all 2026-08 lanes: dataset=shift_suv_surface (estate, fixed reference_length 8.0), res 10000, 500 epochs, lr 3e-3, bf16, augment=false, 4-GPU single-node DDP, AGA
instrument: metrics.jsonl normalized pressure_l2: in-family estate val; zero-shot drivaer_ml val (res 10000) and shift_suv fastback val

deciding_gates.R1_gt_skill_symmetry: GT zero-shot on DrivAerML: mean < 0.8 on 3/3 seeds means the incumbent's transfer skill is direction-symmetric and architecture-generic; mean >= 0.8 means the forward result was partly family/direction luck
deciding_gates.R2_mt_level: MT zero-shot on DrivAerML: mean-predictor level (>= 0.8) predicted; < 0.8 on any seed would be the program's first transfer-skill signal
deciding_gates.R3_infamily_gap_second_family: GT/MT in-family estate ratio; replication band declared 2.0-3.5x (forward measurement was 2.63x)
deciding_gates.R4_mt_boundedness_reverse: MT zero-shot finite and mean < 3.0 on both foreign targets, 3/3 seeds
deciding_gates.R5_fastback_near_transfer: both models zero-shot on fastback (near-family: same platform, different body style) -- descriptive, contextualizes far-transfer numbers

predictions.R1: symmetric skill, p ~ 0.55 (DrivAerML val is 5x smaller in case count than estate-train; geometry statistics differ more in this direction)

falsifier: If R1 fails (GT unskilled in reverse), the incumbent-wins narrative on zero-shot transfer weakens to 'wins on the one measured direction' and the program review statement must say so; if R2 flips (MT skilled in reverse), the mode/convention stack deserves a dedicated follow-up before any incumbent-wins statement.
